name: Scheme of Merit cum Means based Scholarship for Students belonging to the Minority Communities (professional and technical courses)
provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India

rules.quote: Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Jain and Zoroastrians (Parsis) have been notified as minority communities under Section 2 (c) of the National Commission for Minorities Act, 1992.
Scholarship will be awarded to the students who have secured not less than 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous final examination
the annual income of whose parents/guardians from all sources does not exceed Rs.2.50 lakh.

value: technical and professional courses (UG and PG)
rules.quote: It will cover technical and professional courses at undergraduate and post graduate level.

The scholarship is to be awarded for studies in India in a Government or private institution, selected and notified in a transparent manner by the State Government/Union Territory Administration concerned.
30% scholarship is earmarked for girls students of each minority community in a State/UT

rules.value: selection by merit (marks), income as tie-breaker; listed institutions first
rules.quote: Other verified applicant/student will be selected in the merit list, thereafter, on merit basis i.e. Percentage/marks of last academic course/board (higher secondary / graduation) exam. In case of similar marks, income will be taken as deciding factor.

rules.value: max two students per family across MoMA schemes
rules.quote: Scholarship will not be given to more than two students from a family (applicable for all three Scholarship schemes meant for minorities under this Ministry taken together).

rules.value: only one central scholarship for SC/ST/OBC/minority
rules.quote: A student shall be eligible for only one scholarship out of all the available Scholarships of Central Government meant for SC/ST/OBC/minority.
Scholarship will not be paid for the period of internship/housemanship in the M.B.B.S. course or for a practical training in other course if the student is in receipt of some remuneration

amount.text: Course fee up to Rs 20,000 pa (actuals); maintenance allowance Rs 1,000 pm (hosteller) / Rs 500 pm (day scholar) for 10 months; full course fee reimbursed for 85 listed institutes (2017-20 rates)
amount.quote: Course Fee Rs. 20,000/- per annum subject to actuals whichever is less (for both Hosteller & Day Scholar) Maintenance Allowance Rs. 1,000/- per month* for Hosteller Rs. 500/- per month* for Day Scholar Scholarship for listed institutes Full course fee is reimbursed for 85 listed Institutes.

documents.name: Income certificate of parent/guardian
documents.quote: An Income Certificate, issued from a Competent Authority in the State/UT Governments is required in respect of parent/guardian of the student.

documents.name: Self-certified community certificate
documents.quote: A Self-Certified Community Certificate is required from the student who has attained 18 years of age.

documents.name: Aadhaar number
documents.quote: It will be necessary for the eligible applicants to provide Aadhaar number while applying for the scholarship

deadline.text: Apply on NSP; 2026-27 NSP student close 31-10-2026 per registers/nsp_central_2026_27.csv
deadline.quote: It is mandatory for all students to apply online on the website i.e. www.scholarships.gov.in.
